question: What Settings localization contract should OpenClaw support for schema/uiHint-derived config labels, section metadata, and partial PR sequencing?
rationale: UI chrome can use the existing t() locale pipeline, but schema-derived labels cross the config/schema and generated-locale boundary, and two conflicting partial PRs need a maintainer-owned direction before further automation.

options.title: Define one Settings i18n contract
options.body: Sponsor a single key/fallback design for Settings chrome plus schema labels, then ask contributors or ClawSweeper to rebase or replace the partial PRs against it.

options.title: Land only low-risk chrome slices
options.body: Review the toolbar and Quick Settings PRs as narrow slices while leaving schema-derived labels on this canonical issue.

options.title: Defer schema-label localization
options.body: Keep generated schema labels English for now and narrow this issue to fixed, non-schema Settings UI chrome only.

recommendation.title: Define one Settings i18n contract
recommendation.body: Sponsor a single key/fallback design for Settings chrome plus schema labels, then ask contributors or ClawSweeper to rebase or replace the partial PRs against it.
